dataset.name: Three-track static 3D status package
dataset.scope: Preserve V8U through V10S and the immutable V4.2 Blender master. Render only the three-track software/reference/unknown statuses already released by V10P-V10S. Produce six static labelled views, a proof sheet and a new derivative blend. Do not animate impact, fire, initiation, collapse, propagation or arrest; do not add physical values; do not run a structural, thermal, fire or propagation solver; do not feed Blender back into calculations; and do not conclude historical collapse or non-collapse.

observations: The overview cleanly separates the zero-control, official-dependent and unknown-event tracks across four stages.
The full-tower views show the unchanged reference geometry; their darkness does not obscure the status text.
The Floors 93-99 marker is an open orange wireframe with no filled damage or temperature field.
All six individual images display the permanent non-prediction banner without clipping.
No image depicts impact penetration, fire, member failure, collapse, propagation or arrest motion.

rejected_attempts.reason: orthographic and perspective overlays clipped by an incorrect camera-frame convention
orthographic framing corrected but perspective overlays remained clipped

manual_visual_qa.accepted_render_note: The current wtc1_3d_v4/renders/v10t package is the third render attempt and passes the declared visual checks.

epistemic_separation.observed_facts: Current file identities, rendered image dimensions and hashes, static-scene and no-physics counters.
epistemic_separation.official_model_results: Only cached official-model-dependent impact/damage and thermal references already transcribed by V10P-V10R.
epistemic_separation.archive_claims: No source archive is read. One local official PDF is hash-checked without page access.
epistemic_separation.model_hypotheses: Colors, framing, cards and the Floors 93-99 reference frame are presentation choices with zero mechanical credit.
epistemic_separation.derived_results: Three-track by four-stage status matrix, derivative blend, six stills and proof sheet.
epistemic_separation.unknowns: Historical damage, fire, member temperatures, initiation, propagation, arrest and final outcome remain unknown.

next_iteration.objective: Qualifier un premier cas mécanique borné et indépendant dans CalculiX avec solution analytique, convergence de maillage et bilan force-déplacement. Le cas doit rester un benchmark logiciel de composant sans attribution au WTC 1 tant que les plans, sections, assemblages et chemins d’efforts réels manquent.
